title: João Goulart (Jango) to Ladislau Abreu, São Borja to Rio, March 1946 (catalogue 1488, CPDOC GV c 1946.03.09/2): open-code telegram read with the filed code list 'Cifra (Ladislau para João Goulart)'; one cover name resolved (Bartolomeu = H. Borghi), one boxed code word (VIVILA) open

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the form. The recipient boxed VIVILA in ink and someone pencilled 'Código' in the margin. The code list is a separate sheet in the same fonds, GV c 1946/1950.00.00/5.

transcription.notes: Teleprinter capitals on pasted strips. Two passes (full image; fresh 2x crops) agree word for word, 20 of 20. Length counted in plain-language words (20, including both PT), which is also the word count in the telegraph preamble (RS 20/...).

system.summary: Open code (jargon): a plain-language Portuguese telegram in which cover words stand for parties, people and offices. The filed list 'Cifra (Ladislau para João Goulart)' gives 25 typed pairs (P.T.B. = Sociedade, P.S.D. = Companhia, U.D.N. = Firma, P.C.B. = Empreza, H. Borghi = Bartolomeu, Dutra = Manoel, Getulio Vargas = Varela, Ministro = fornecedor, jornal = anuncio, Constituinte = reunião, and others), with later ink and pencil additions, and a second set of stock phrases for weekly telegrams to Alzira signed Maneco. In this telegram one word is on the list (BARTOLOMEU) and one other word is boxed in ink as code (VIVILA) but is not on the list.
system.notes: Not a letter or figure cipher: every word is a Portuguese word or name; only the meaning of the cover words is hidden. The second key named in the catalogue, GV c 1950.02.00/1 (1950, Amaral Peixoto; first names for politicians, car makes for candidates), is another code and gives nothing on this telegram (0 of 20 words).

prior_solution.where: No decipherment on the form. No edition or modern reading of this telegram found: one web search on 12 Nov 2026 ('Vivila' with Vargas, Jango, Goulart, 1946) found nothing on the term; the catalogue vetting of 3 Nov 2026 found nothing in DECODE, Tomokiyo or Lasry and three Portuguese searches found only biographies and PTB histories. A DocReader full-text (OCR) search of CorrespGV3 on 12 Nov 2026 gives no hit for VIVILA.

solution.what: Telegram (pagfis 521), code list GV c 1946/1950.00.00/5 (pagfis 1852) and the three pages of GV c 1950.02.00/1 (pagfis 4665-4667) fetched from the CPDOC DocReader by replaying the viewer's image-load postback, one request at a time, 2 s apart. No login, no captcha.

Sign conventions written before the key was applied; telegram transcribed in two independent passes (full image, 2x crops). Code list transcribed from its image (typed entries; ink and pencil additions read in part).
Typed entries of the filed list frozen as key_frozen.tsv before decoding. The key was not built from the telegram.

Key applied to the telegram (not used to build it): of the two words that stand out as code (BARTOLOMEU, and VIVILA boxed in ink), 1 of 2 is on the list. BARTOLOMEU = H. Borghi fits the date: Hugo Borghi was a PTB leader in São Paulo early in 1946. The 1950 list matches 0 of 20 words. Full-text search of CorrespGV3 for further uses of the code: BARTOLOMEU 10 hits (this telegram, the code list, 8 personal names in newspapers and PTB name lists), VARELA 6 hits (the code list; 3 of the other 5 viewed, all the real surname), VIVILA 0 hits. No second text in the code was found for a further test.

Telegram decoded mechanically (scripts/decrypt.py) and read as Portuguese with every departure marked; scripts/check_marks.py rebuilds the decryption and fails on an unmarked departure (passes; a tamper test fails as it should). 18 words without PT: 15 verbatim, 1 resolved code word, 1 expanded abbreviation (SAUDS), 1 hole (VIVILA).
One web search on VIVILA with Vargas, Jango and Goulart (nothing); the catalogue vetting searches of 3 Nov 2026 reviewed.

Blind review by an independent AI language-model agent: it read the image before opening the transcription (20 of 20 text words agree), re-ran decrypt.py and check_marks.py, ran its own tamper test, and read the text as sentences against the translation (grade A, read in part). It found no transcription error; the checker word-list gaps and a suggested reading of the preamble figures were added to NOTES.md.

texts.label: Telegram, São Borja to Rio, March 1946, signed Jango
texts.summary: On 'our business': Goulart asks Ladislau Abreu to tell H. Borghi (cover name Bartolomeu) that he may handle the matter without making any commitment, since this will depend on a new understanding; the last code word, VIVILA, is open.
texts.note: 20 words in the telegram text, 18 without the two PT (full stop). 15 read verbatim from the strips, 1 code word resolved with the filed list (BARTOLOMEU = H. Borghi), 1 abbreviation written out (SAUDS = saudações), 1 hole (VIVILA, boxed in ink on the form as code, not on the list). Sense from the signs 17/18 = 94.4%. NEGOCIO is not on the list and is read as the plain word. Dan's reading checker gives clean share 0/2 for the Portuguese text (hole rate 0.375): its Portuguese word list lacks words of the telegram (negócio, avise, assunto, assumir, compromisso, dependerá, novo, saudações, and the name Jango); the English translation scores 3/3.

reading_review.note: Read as Portuguese telegraph style against the translation: both sentences hold, and the only hole is the boxed code word VIVILA, which is not on the filed list. The strip text was checked word for word on the image (20 of 20 agree); the checker's 0/2 on the Portuguese comes from gaps in its period word list, not from holes in the reading.

gaps.item: VIVILA, the word boxed in ink as code
gaps.detail: Not on the typed list, not among the ink or pencil additions as read, not on the 1950 list, no OCR hit in CorrespGV3. The scribble under it inside the box is not legible.
Read as the plain word ('our business'); it may itself be agreed jargon not on the list.

gaps.item: Faint pencil on the code list
gaps.detail: The four lines at the top right and the pencil name after Bartolomeu ('Ferreira', 'Ferraz' or 'Teixeira') are read only in part.

gaps.item: Direction of the ink additions on the code list
gaps.detail: 'leader = representante' against 'crise = revolução' is not fixed; no text in the code uses them.
No second text in this code was found; both rest on one telegram and on a single code word (BARTOLOMEU).
